WI-FI
Pair with a computer

1. Connect the tablet to Wi-Fi and the computer to the same local network (not a guest network).

2. On the computer, open DrawSplay settings, turn on Wi-Fi, choose your network interface and save.

3. In Host overview, select Show pairing code. Keep this screen open, enter that code below, then approve the tablet on the computer.

Android could not use this tablet’s secure Wi-Fi identity. Forgetting the host alone may not fix this. Restart the tablet and retry; if it persists, use USB and check the Android Keystore error in the app logs. No identity is reset automatically.
Pairing did not finish. Check the computer and network, then try again with a fresh code. If a pairing was saved, use Back and Forget wireless host first.
Try again

Remove this tablet’s saved wireless host and stop reconnecting to it? To reconnect, you will need a new pairing code and approval on the computer.\n\nThis only forgets the computer on this tablet. It does not remove the tablet from the computer, reset the tablet’s Wi-Fi identity or change USB and display settings.
Switch wireless computer
This tablet already has a saved host. Forget it first to stop automatic reconnecting, then use Wi-Fi connect to pair with another computer. This does not remove the tablet from the old computer.

For the simplest connection, start DrawSplay on your computer and connect a USB data cable. Unlock the tablet and allow the USB accessory prompt if Android shows one. No Developer options are needed for USB accessory mode.\n\nPrefer wireless? Use Wi-Fi connect below.
